# DAWproject 1.0 schemas and example

Studio Duo vendors the authoritative DAWproject 1.0 files from
[`bitwig/dawproject`](https://github.com/bitwig/dawproject) tag `v1.0.0`,
commit `1651bf069601be47b028052f9c6dd5d20a05ddb5`.

Included files:

- `v1.0.0/Project.xsd` — SHA-256
  `794aada904501da5d2005291500402e1cd6f40fab55e0e2eadafd4d9666786a7`
- `v1.0.0/MetaData.xsd` — SHA-256
  `093c820c0a500580fcea3eb7054f8371bd55a1fd8f0622622350ee7f4b351224`
- `v1.0.0/examples/bitwig-readme-project.xml` — the project XML example
  published in the tagged upstream README
- `v1.0.0/LICENSE` — upstream MIT license

The schemas are embedded into Studio Duo and used without runtime network
access. The example is a schema fixture only; its referenced audio and plug-in
state are not redistributed.
